scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @workspace/api-server" "npm run dev -w @workspace/savora"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api-server --workspace=apps/savora --workspace=scripts --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @workspace/api-server && npm run test -w @workspace/savora
